source.name: Chapter 6: 1.3 Test Your Knowledge - Explore Mortgage Options
source.instructions: Your banking agent already handles transfers via a guided flow. A product manager asks you to add a feature where users can explore their mortgage options in a free-form conversation comparing rates, running affordability calculations, asking follow-up questions. Which approach fits best?

answers.answer: A sub-agent with MCP tools that can look up products, run calculations, and adapt to wherever the conversation goes
A new guided flow with slots for each mortgage variable
An additional document added to `docs/` for the `EnterpriseSearchPolicy`
Extend the existing transfer flow with extra steps for mortgage questions

source.learningObjectives: SWBAT explain which dialogue management style to use
source.guidance: This conversation has no predictable shape. The user might ask about rates, then affordability, then a follow-up you did not anticipate. A sub-agent is built for exactly this, since it is prompt-driven it can reason, call a tool, process the result, adapt, repeat.
